app.title: Show HN: SolidCraft – Open-Source Parametric CAD in Rust (With MCP Support)
app.author: bherbruck
app.description: A Rust‑based parametric CAD engine with support for Metal‑Capped‑Pipes (MCP) rendering and a command‑line interface for generating 3D models.
proposed_tests: Cargo build --release and measure build time
Generate a simple cube model via CLI and export to STL, then validate file size < 5KB
Render the cube using MCP and compare rendered image dimensions 512x512
Measure memory usage during model generation
